2. `filler.fillAndSubmit()` (FormFillerAgent, queue-processor.ts:1308-1319) drives real Playwright browser automation that fills and submits a real web form on a funder/government portal, gated only by an existing `automation_sessions` approval row (BEHAVIORAL_CONTRACTS Section 18 / CRITICAL ISSUE #15), with no dry-run flag anywhere in the file.
Grepped worker/queue-processor.ts and src/lib/autoapply/email-submitter.ts for any dry-run/simulate/sandbox/test-mode flag (dryRun, dry_run, DRY_RUN, simulate, sandbox, test.mode) -- zero matches. No safe way exists in this codebase today to exercise this pipeline's real write path without either sending a real email to a real recipient or driving a real browser through a real third-party form submission.
This decision is independently corroborated by this project's own prior audit history: FEATURE_REGISTRY_v2.md's T7 (Soak Tests) row documents a 2026-08-13 AutoApply queue-processor soak test that deliberately avoided the real browser-automation/email-submission code path for the same reason -- "all 50 items took the no_portal_or_email fast-skip path by design, to avoid firing real automated submissions at real funder portals" (SOAK_TEST_AUTOAPPLY_RESULTS_20260813.md). This session applies the same standing caution rather than being the first to break it.
No local schema patch or seed data was needed since no invocation was attempted.

Per this task's explicit scope rule, this cannot be safely fired against a fake/local target in a way that would prove anything meaningful without risking a real submission reaching a real recipient (e.g. a synthetic 'PT-09 Test' funder contact email would still be a genuine email delivery attempt to whatever real mailbox that address resolves to). This does not mean the code is untested in general -- worker/queue-processor.ts's own logic up to the submission decision point, and its Human Review Queue / CAPTCHA-pause paths, have real prior live-verification coverage documented elsewhere in this project's AGENT_VERIFICATION_LOG.md and SOAK_TEST_AUTOAPPLY_RESULTS_20260813.md -- only the final real-send/real-submit step is out of scope for this specific proof.
